notes.title: CLARITY UPDATE - v.1.2
notes.content:
Hey all, 

This update contains the following changes:
-----------------------------------------------

 Monster spawns were moved further from ladders
 A billboard was added to the start, providing more initial help and clarity about the player's goal
 Caution signs were added near the dropdown areas in the maze
 A guided path was added to the start to help with finding the forest level ladder

Thank you all for playing, this may be one of the last updates for the game as our team is aiming to release and start other products. Please let us know if you have any more changes you would like to see in Burning Out!

notes.title: RELEASE HOT FIXES - v.1.1
notes.content:
Thank you all for your support and patience! We have published a release patch with the following updates:

Small Changes

 Changed the “Tutorial” text in the pause menu to “Controls”
 Changed the settings text in the Pause Menu to reflect the Main Menu


Bug Fixes

 Fixed Syncing issues when joining Multiplayer Lobbies
 Fixed Mouse Acceleration Issue Near Maze Walls

notes.title: Official Release - In Progress Patch
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for taking the chance to purchase or play our product! We're currently hard at work trying to fix some bug's we're experiencing on launch. If you're experiencing issues with the multiplayer please be patient as we are working hard to fix syncing issues.

We will publish an update soon, we appreciate your support! ːsteamhappyː

Stay Burnt.

- Burnt Out Games
